text.en:
Intrinsically grants Fastball, even on non-Tripmine Grenades

Enhanced Tripmine Grenade:
 • 14% Increased Explosion Damage. Explosion Length and Width are increased to 14 metres.
 • Explosion no longer deals self-damage and has no damage falloff.
 • Lasts 30 seconds. (10s -> 30s)
 • Increases Tripmine Durability to 100 HP with 50% Damage Resist.

<solar/>Solar Ability Damage recharges 33% of Tripmine Grenade Ability. 
<yellow/>Ember of Ashes allows each Tripmine to count as 2 instances of Solar Ability Damage.
text.zh-chs:
让手雷自带快速投掷能力。

增强感应手雷：
 • 爆炸伤害增加 14%。爆炸的长度和宽度增加到 14 米。
 • 爆炸不再造成自我伤害，并且没有伤害衰减。
 • 持续 30 秒。(10s -> 30s)
 • 将感应手雷的耐久度提高到 100 生命值，并有 50% 的伤害抵抗。

<solar/>烈日技能伤害可为感应手雷充能 33%。
<yellow/>骨灰余烬可让感应手雷算作 2 次烈日技能伤害。
